description: This file is a test suite for checking the generation of utility classes in a SASS-based CSS framework. It imports necessary dependencies, defines utility values and breakpoints, and includes assertions to verify the correct output of CSS classes for margin, padding, and font-size across different media queries.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite for a specific feature or component.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines an individual test case within a test suite.

methods.name: assert
methods.description: Sets up assertions to verify the expected output of utility class generation.

methods.name: output
methods.description: Outputs the generated CSS classes for verification.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Specifies the expected CSS classes and styles that should be generated.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes mixins or external files into the current scope.
